m: सम्-√ 3. मा P. Ā. -माति, -मिमीते, to measure out, measure, RV. &c. &c.; to make of the same measure, make equal, equalize (in size, number, quantity &c.), AV.; TS.; ŚBr. ; to compare with (instr.), BhP.; to mete out, distribute, bestow, RV. iii, 1, 15; v, 4, 2; (with श्रवांसि) to direct one's course or flight towards, ib. iii, 34, 22; to be of the same capacity with, be contained in (loc.), Kuval. : Pass. -मीयते, to be of the same measure, be contained in (loc.), Nīlak.
सम्-मा f. equality in size or number, symmetry, AitBr.; PañcavBr.
a kind of metre, RPrāt.
सम्-माद m. great exhilaration, intoxication, frenzy, L.

s: puM, (sam + mana + GaY .) samAdaraH । yaTA, tiTyAditattve । “janmarkzayuktA yadi janmamAse yasya DruvaM janmatiTirBavecca । Bavanti tadvatsarameva yAvannErujyasammAnasuKAni tasya ॥”
m: 1. सम्-मान m. or (accord. to some) n. (for 2. See col. 2) honour, respect, homage, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
2. सम्-मान n. (for 1. See सम्-√ मन्) the act of measuring out, equalizing, comparing, MW.
measure, ib.
1. 2. सम्-मान See सम्-√ मन् and सम्- √ 3. मा, col. 1.
1. सम्-मान—कर mfn. doing honour, honouring, RPrāt.
सम्-˚माननीय mfn. (fr..id.) to be honoured or respected, BhP.
सम्-˚मानन n. (or f(आ). ; fr. Caus.) the act of honouring, worshipping, homage, Nir.; Pāṇ.; MBh. &c.
सम्-˚मानिन् mfn. having a sense of honour, Kāv.

s: tri, (sammAno'sya jAtaH । sammAna + itac .) samAdftaH । gOravitaH । yaTA, mArkaRqeyapurARe । 82 । 70 । “anyErapi surErddevI BUzaRErAyuDEstaTA । sammAnitA nanAdoccEH sAwwahAsaM muhurmmuhuH ॥”
v: strI sama + mana--Ric॰ kta । 1 kftagOrave 2 samAdfte ca ।
m: सम्-˚मानित mfn. (fr. id.) honoured, treated with reverence or respect, Kāv.; Kathās.
सम्-˚मानित—विमानित mfn. (first) honoured and (then) disgraced, Ml.
सम्-˚मान्य mfn. to be (or being) highly honoured by (gen.), R.
सम्-मार्ग , सम्-मार्जक &c. See सम्-√ मृज्., p. 1181, col. 1.
सम्-मार्ग m. wiping off, cleansing, Kum.; TBr., Sch.
a wisp of grass (for tying faggots together), ŚrS.
सम्-मार्जक mfn. sweeping, cleansing, a sweeper, Kull. on Mn. vii, 126

सम्-मार्जक m. a broom, L.

m: सम्-˚मार्जन n. the act of sweeping or cleansing thoroughly, cleansing, scouring, purifying, brushing, ŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
the anointing and washing (of images &c.), MW.
a wisp (or bunch of Darbha grass for purifying ladles &c.), TBr.; KātyŚr.
remains of food wiped off from dishes &c., MārkP.
a wisp or broom (made of tough grass and stalks), Saṃskārak.; Kull.
सम्-˚मार्जित mfn. well swept or scoured, MBh.; Hariv.
removed, destroyed, Rājat.

s: puM, (sammArjjayatIti । saM + mfj + Rvul .) sammArjanI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ samyaNmArjjanakarttari, tri ॥

strI, (saMmfjyate'nayeti । saM + mfj + lyuw । NIp .) DUlyAdimArjanasADanI । ko~stA iti JA~wA iti ca BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । SoDanI 2 । ityamaraH । 2 । 2 । 18 ॥ UhanI 3 samUhanI 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ bahukarI 5 vardDanI 6 । iti hemacandraH ॥

2. सम्-मातृ or सम्-मातृ mfn. (for 1. See above) having the same mother, twin, RV.; AV.; Kāṭh.

m: सम्मातुर w.r. for साम्मातुर, q.v.

सम्-√ मील् P. -मीलति, to shut the eyes, RV.; Br.; GṛŚrS.; to close up (as a flower), Śak.; Suśr. : Caus. -मीलयति (with or without नेत्रे), to close the eyes, Kālid.; Kathās.; Suśr.; to cause to close the eyes i.e. make insensible, kill, Uttarar.; Sāh.
सम्-मीलन n. closing (of a flower, of the eyes &c.), Suśr.
cessation of activity, Daśar.
covering up, obscuring, a total eclipse, Sūryas.
सम्-˚मीलित (सम्-), mfn. one who has closed the eyes, TS.
closed (as eyes &c.), asleep (opp. to वि-बुद्ध, ‘awake’), Suśr.; Ragh.
सम्-˚मीलित—द्रुम m. a Punarnavā with red flowers, L.
1. सम्-˚मील्य ind. having closed or shut or covered, RV.; &c.
2. सम्-˚मील्य n. N. of a Sāman, Br.
सम्-मूढा (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma, Cat.

foolish, ignorant, Yājñ.; Rājat.
heaped, accumulated (as clouds; accord. to others, ‘torn asunder’), Hariv.
produced rapidly, W.
broken, ib.
सम्-मूढ—चेतस् mfn. troubled or infatuated in mind, Śāntiś.
सम्-मूढ—हृदय mfn. troubled in heart, MW.
सम्-मूढ—पिडका f. N. of partic. eruptions on the membrum virile, Suśr.
सम्-मूढ—ता f. (Kathās.) stupefaction, infatuation, bewilderment, unconsciousness
सम्-मूढ—त्व n. (MaitrUp.) stupefaction, infatuation, bewilderment, unconsciousness
सम्-मूर्छ m. (prob.) thickening, augmenting, increase, expansion, spreading, L.
सम्-मूर्छ—ज m. grass or any gramineous plant, ib.
सम्-˚मूर्छन n. the act of congealing or thickening, increasing, spreading, accumulating, Kaṇ.
stupefaction, insensibility, fainting away, L.
height, elevation, W.
सम्-˚मूर्छ˚नोद्भव m. a fish or other aquatic animal, L.
सम्-˚मूर्छित mfn. coagulated, congealed, thickened, strengthened, intensified (ifc. = ‘filled with’), R.; Suśr.
stupefied, senseless, unconscious, MBh.; R.
reflected (as rays), VarBṛS.
modulated (as tone), Bhar.
सम्-˚मूर्छित—वत् mfn. one who has (or = he has) formed or shaped, Śaṃk.

v: na॰ sammUcCAt jAyate jana--qa । tfRAdO hemaca॰

सम्-मथित mfn. bruised, pounded, dashed to pieces, destroyed, ib.

सम्-√ मद् P. Ā. -मदति, ˚ते, to rejoice together, rejoice with (instr.), RV.; to rejoice at, delight in (instr.), ib.; VS. : Caus. -मदयति, ˚ते, to intoxicate, exhilarate, AitBr.; (Ā.) to be completely intoxicated or exhilarated, AV.; AitBr.
सम्-मद् f. (used to explain समद्), Nir. ix, 17.

of a king of the fish, VP.
सम्-˚मद mfn. = next, W.

m: सम्-˚मद—मय mf(ई)n. greatly exhilarated, happy, glad, Kathās.
सम्-˚मद—वत् mfn. ‘being together in rut or sexual passion’, and ‘feeling delight’, Bālar.
सम्-˚मदिन् mfn. gladdening, exhilarating, Bhām.
सम्-मग्न mfn. (√ मज्ज्) sunk down, immersed in or overwhelmed by (comp.), MBh.; R.
सम्-महस् n. (prob.) common or mutual joy (see महस्), ŚrS.

सम्-√ मन् Ā. मन्यते (ep. also P. ˚ति), to think together, agree, assent to, approve (see सम्-मत below); to think, fancy, MBh.; to regard or consider as (acc. or two acc.), ib. &c.; to mean, contemplate, intend, resolve, R.; to think highly of, esteem, value, honour, MBh.; R. : Caus. -मानयति, to honour, reverence, respect, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.; to regard, consider, Bhaṭṭ.; to assure any one (gen.) of (acc.), MārkP. : Desid. of Caus. See सम्-मिमानयिषु below.
सम्-मनस् mfn. unanimous, AV.; ŚBr.
सम्-√ मन्द् Ā. -मन्दते, to rejoice at, delight in (instr.), RV. viii, 12, 16; (aor. -अमन्दिषुः), to intoxicate, exhilarate, ib. 52, 10.
सम्-˚मनिमन् m. unanimousness, harmony g. दृढादि.
सम्-˚मन्तव्य mfn. to be highly valued, MBh.

सम्-√ मन्त्र् P. -मन्त्रयति (ind.p. -मन्त्र्य, or -मन्त्रयित्वा), to consult together, take council with (instr. with or without सह or समम्), MBh.; R. &c.; to hold a council, deliberate, advise, express an opinion, R.; to salute, greet, address, MBh.
सम्-मन्त्रणीय mfn. to be consulted, MW.
to be saluted, MBh.
सम्-मन्त्रित mfn. deliberated, considered, Kathās.
सम्-मर्शन , ˚शिन्. See सम्√ मृश्, p. 1181, col. 1.
सम्-मर्शन n. stroking, ŚBr.; ŚrS.
सम्-˚मर्शिन् mfn. able to judge, TUp.

सम्-मर्द m. pressing or rubbing together, friction, pressure, Pratāp.
trampling, MBh.; R. &c.
impact (of waves), Rājat.
meeting, encounter (esp. with enemies), war, battle, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-˚मर्दन m. N. of a son of Vasu-deva, BhP.
of a king of the Vidyā-dharas, Kathās.
सम्-˚मर्दन n. rubbing, friction, Siṃhās.

m: सम्-˚मर्दिन् mfn. pressing thoroughly, rubbing, crushing, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-मर्ष m. = मर्ष, patience, endurance, BhP.
सम्-मता (आ), f. N. of a daughter of Marutta, Hariv.
of a treatise on the Dhātu-pāṭha
सम्-˚मतीय m. N. of one of the four divisions of the Vaibhāṣika system of Buddhism (said to have been founded by Upāli, a disciple of Gautama Buddha), MWB. 157 n. 1 &c.
सम्-मत mfn. thinking together, being of the same opinion, agreed, consented or assented to, concurred in, approved by (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(ifc.) agreeing with, BhP.
thought, supposed, considered or regarded as (nom.), R.
thought highly of, esteemed, renowned, celebrated, highly honoured by (gen.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
allowed, authorized (see अ-सम्मत)
सम्-मत m. N. of a son of Manu Sāvarṇa, Hariv.
(pl.) of a school, Buddh.
सम्-मत (अम्), n. opinion, impression (ए or एन with gen., ‘in the opinion of’, ‘under the idea of’), MBh.
consent, assent, approval, acquiescence, concurrence (ए, ‘with the consent or approval of’), MW.

s: strI, (saM + mana + ktin .) aBilAzaH । anujYA । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, kirAte । 10 । 36 । “kaTamiva tava sammatirBavitrI samamftuBirmuninAvaDIritasya ॥”) AtmajYAnam । ityajayapAlaH ॥
v: strI sam + mana--ktin । 1 anumatO 2 aBilAze ca medi॰ । 3 AtmajYAne ajayaH ।
m: सम्-˚मति f. sameness of opinion, harmony, agreement, approval, approbation, ĀśvŚr.; Prab.; Hit.
opinion, view, Siddh.
respect, homage, R.; Kir.
wish, desire, L.
self-knowledge, L.
regard, affection, love, W.
order, command, ib.
N. of a river, VP.
सम्-˚मति mfn. being of the same opinion, agreeing g. द्रिढादि (-मन् m., ib.)
सम्-˚मति m. N. of a son of Harṣa, VP.
सम्-˚मति—मन् m., ib.
सम्-मत्त mfn. completely intoxicated (lit. and fig.), exhilarated, enraptured, enamoured, MBh.; Hariv.
rutting, in rut, ib.
सम्-मय , ˚यन. See सम्- √ 1. मि.
सम्-मय m. (of unknown meaning), Vop. xxvi, 171 (v.l.)
सम्-˚मयन (सम्-), n. erection of a sacrificial post, ŚBr.
सम्-मेघ m. the cloudy season, TāṇḍBr.
सम्मेद m. N. of a mountain (-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.), Cat.
सम्मेद—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
सम्-मेलन n. mingling or meeting together, mixture, union, Uttarar.; Sāh.
सम्-मेलन See सम्-√ मिल्.
सम्मेत m. (cf. समेत and next) N. of a mountain, Śatr.
सम्-√ मृण् P. -मृणति, to kill, slay, destroy, RV.; Kāṭh.
सम्-√ मृश् P. Ā. -मृशति, ˚ते, to take hold of, seize, grasp, touch, graze, stroke (Ā. ‘each other’), ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.; to touch mentally, judge (see below).

सम्-√ मृद् P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दति (Ved. inf. -मर्दितोः), to press or squeeze together, rub or grind to pieces, crush, destroy, TS. : Caus. -मर्दयति (pr. p. -मर्दयान), to cause to be rubbed together, crush, pound, bruise, R.; BhP.; to rub, Suśr.; to clean, MW.

सम्-√ मृज् P. -मृजति, -मार्ष्टि, -मार्जति, -मार्जयति (cf. √ मार्ज्), to sweep together, sweep clean, rub or wipe off, cleanse, strain, filter (Soma), purify (fire by removing ashes), RV. &c. &c.; to take away, remove, Rājat.; to stroke, caress, R.
सम्-मृत mfn. quite dead, W.

strained, filtered, L.

m: सम्-√ 1. मि P. Ā. -मिनोति, -मिनुते, to fasten at the same time or together, fix, erect, TS.; ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.
सम्-मिश्ल mf(आ)n. = सम्-मिश्र above, RV.
सम्-मिश्ल m. ‘universal mingler’, N. of Indra, MBh.

m: सम्-मिश्र mf(आ)n. commingled, mixed together, joined, connected, furnished or endowed with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
सम्-˚मिश्रण n. the act of commingling or mixing together, Kull. on Mn. vii, 193.
सम्-˚मिश्रित mfn. mixed together, mingled, intermixed with (instr.), MBh.
सम्-√ मिह् See सम्- √ 1. मिक्ष् and √ 1. मिक्ष्, √ 1. मिह्.

सम्-√ मिल् P. Ā. -मिलति, ˚ते, to meet or assemble together, be present, associate with, Kathās.
सम्-मिलित mfn. met together, assembled, collected, ib.; Pañcat.
सम्-मिमानयिषु mfn. (fr. Desid. of Caus.) wishing to honour or revere, MBh.
सम्-मिमानयिषु See सम्√ मन्, col. 1.
सम्-मिमर्दिषु See सम्√ मृद्, p. 1181, col. 1.
सम्-मिमर्दिषु mfn. about to crush, MBh.

s: tri, (saM + mA + ktaH .) samAnaparimARaH । sadfSaH । iti jawADaraH ॥

m: सम्-मित mfn. measured out, measured, meted, BhP.
measuring so much, just so much (no more nor less), MBh.; BhP.
of the same measure or extent, equal, like, same (in length, height, number, value &c.), corresponding to, resembling, passing for (instr., rarely gen.; or comp.), AV. &c. &c.
reaching up to (comp.), ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.
symmetrical (?), Pañcar.
consisting of, furnished or provided with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; Pañcar.
destined for (comp.), MBh. v, 2462 (B. संधित)
सम्-मित m. N. of a mythical being, Yājñ.
of a son of Vasiṣṭha, VP.
सम्-मित n. distance (ए ifc. = ‘at a distance from’), VarBṛS.
सम्-मित &c. See above.
सम्-मितम् (अम्), ind. perpetually, incessantly, Kāraṇḍ. (prob. w.r. for समितम्)
सम्-मित—त्व n. (in rhet.) universal analogy, Pratāp.
सम्-मित—वर्णा f. N. of a Commentary.
सम्-˚मिति f. equalization, comparison, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 35 (v.l. सम्-इति).
सम्-मोचित mfn. (fr. Caus.) set free, liberated, released, Ragh.

s: puM, (saM + mud + GaY .) prItiH । harzaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ sam + muda--GaY । 1 harze 2 prItO ca Sabdaca॰ ।
m: सम्-मोद m. id., L.
odour, fragrance, MBh. (v.l.)
सम्-मोद , ˚दन &c. See सम्√ मुद्, p. 1180, col. 3.
सम्-मोद—गन्ध m. id., Jātakam.
सम्-˚मोदमान (Divyāv.) mfn. friendly, ib.
सम्-˚मोदनी-कथा f., ‘complimentary talk’
सम्-˚मोदनीय (Mahāvy.) mfn. friendly, ib.
सम्-˚मोदन mf(ई)n. friendly, kind (˚नी-कथा f. ‘complimentary talk’), Divyāv.
सम्-˚मोदिक m. a kind or friendly person, comrade, companion, SaddhP.
सम्-मोहा (आ), f. a kind of metre, Col.
सम्-मोह m. stupefaction, bewilderment, confusion, insensibility, unconsciousness, ignorance, folly, illusion of mind (also with मनसः; मनः-, मति-, चित्त-स्˚ &c.), ŚBr. &c. &c.
tumult, battle (= संग्रान), Naigh. ii, 17
(in astrol.) a partic. conjunction of planets, VarBṛS.
सम्-मोह , ˚हक, ˚हन &c. See col. 1.
सम्-मोहक mfn. (fr. Caus.) stupefying, infatuating, bewitching, fascinating, MBh.
सम्-मोह—मौलिन् mfn. having illusion for a diadem, MaitrUp.
सम्-˚मोहनी (ई), f. a kind of fascination or illusion (माया), Hariv.
सम्-˚मोहन mf(ई)n. (fr. Caus.) id., MBh.; Hariv. &c.
सम्-˚मोहन m. N. of one of the five arrows of Kāmadeva, Kum.; Gīt., Sch. (cf. RTL. 200)
सम्-˚मोहन n. deluding, infatuating, leading astray, MārkP.
a kind of mythical weapon, MBh.; Ragh.; Kathās.

k.v: शम्बरारिर्मनसिजः कुसुमेषुरनन्यजः। पुष्पधन्वा रतिपतिर्मकरध्वज आत्मभूः। अरविन्दमशोकं च चूतं च नवमल्लिका। नीलोत्पलं च पञ्चैते पञ्चबाणस्य सायकाः। उन्मादनस्तापनश्च शोषणः स्तम्भनस्तथा। संमोहनश्च कामस्य पञ्च बाणाः प्रकीर्तिताः॥

m: सम्-˚मोहन—तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
सम्-˚मोहित mfn. (fr. id.) stupefied, bewildered, fascinated, enraptured, R.; Gīt.; BhP.
सम्-√ मोक्ष् P. -मोक्षयति, to set quite free, liberate, MBh.
सम्-म्रक्षित mfn. (√ म्रक्ष्) rubbed in, anointed, Suśr.
सम्मुखी in comp. for ˚ख.
सम्मुखी—√ भू P. -भवति, to be or stand face to face or opposite, be opposed to, Bālar.
सम्मुखी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to place facing, make one's chief aim (˚खीकृत mfn. ‘aimed at’), Rāghav.

s: tri, (sarvvasya muKasya darSanaH । sammuKa + “yaTAmuKasammuKasya darSanaH KaH .” 5 । 2 । 6 । iti KaH .) aBimuKaH । iti hemacandraH । 6 । 73 ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 15 । 17 । “apaSUlaM tamAsAdya lavaRaM lakzmaRAnujaH । ruroDasammuKIno hi jayo ranDraprahAriRAm ॥”)
v: tri॰ sammuKa patati Ka । aBimuKe pAtini ।
m: सम्मुखीन mf(आ)n. facing, confronting, opposite, Bhaṭṭ.; Hcar. &c.
propitious, favourable to (gen.), Ragh.
सम्मुखीन—त्व n. the being in front, Kull. on Mn. iv, 52
presence, Sāh.

s: tri, (samyak muKaM yasya .) aBimuKAgataH । tatparyyAyaH । BagnapfzWaH 2 । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 27 । 138 । “tasyAM vikramasiMhAKyo baBUvAnvarTayAKyayA । rAjA vErimfgA yasya nEvAsan sammuKAH kvacit ॥” aBimuKe, klI । sumuKa iti BAzA ॥ yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 4 । 70 । “nASakat sammuKe sTAtuM kazwo hyavinayakramaH ॥” taTA ca sAhityadarpaRe । 3 । 154 । “dfzwA darSayati vrIqAM sammuKaM nEva paSyati ॥” sarvvaM muKamiti nipAtanAt antalope sammuKamiti sidDam । iti SabdArTacintAmaRiH ॥ samastamuKe ca klI । iti kASikA । 5 । 2 । 6 ॥)
v: tri॰ saNgataM muKaM yena prA॰ ba॰ । aBimuKAgate trikA॰ ।
m: सम्-मुख mf(ई rarely आ)n. facing, fronting, confronting, being face to face or in front of or opposite to (gen. or ifc. or ibc.), present, before the eyes, ŚBr. &c. &c.
being about to begin or at the beginning of (comp.), Hariv.
directed or turned towards, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
inclined or favourable to (gen. or comp.), propitious, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
intent upon (loc. or comp.), Śatr.; Kathās.
adapted to circumstances, fit, suitable, Lalit.
with the mouth or face, ĀpŚr.
सम्-मुखम् (अम्), ind. towards, near to (अत्मनः, ‘one's self’)
opposite, in front or in presence of (gen.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-मुख—विनय m. (prob.) reproving any one face to face (i.e. when he is alone and no one else present), Mahāvy.
सम्-मुखय Nom. P. ˚यति, to aim at (loc.), Bhām.
सम्-मुखे (ए), ind. opposite, before, face to face, in front or in presence or in the beginning of (gen. or comp.; with √ भू, ‘to oppose, resist’; with √ स्था, ‘to look any one in the face’), ib.
सम्-मुखिन् m. a looking-glass, mirror, L.
सम्-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति, to let loose together, pour out, discharge, shed (tears), MBh. : Caus. -मोचयति See next.
सम्-√ मुद् (only in pr. p. -मोदमान, q.v.)
सम्-मुद् f. joy, delight (cf. स्वादु-स्˚), AV.
सम्-मुग्ध mfn. gone astray (see अ-स्˚)
perplexed, bewildered, stupefied, Uttarar.
not clearly understood, Nīlak.
सम्-मुग्धम् (अम्), ind. furtively, Gīt.

सम्-√ मुह् P. -मुह्यति (pf. -मुमोह, or -मुमुह्स्), to become quite stupefied or bewildered or unconscious, MBh.; R.; BhP.; to become confused or unrecognizable (as the quarters of the sky), MBh.: Caus. -मोहयति, to stupefy, make unconscious, perplex, bewilder, lead astray, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

सम्-√ मुर्छ् (or -मूर्छ्) P. -मूर्छति, to congeal into a fixed form, become dense, thicken, coagulate, Kāv.; VarBṛS.; Suśr.; to become stupid or senseless (see -मूर्छित); to acquire consistency or firmness or strength, increase, expand, become powerful, make a loud sound, Ragh. : Caus. -मूर्छयति, to cause to assume consistency, form, fashion (see -मूर्छित-वत्); to stupefy, cause to faint, Uttarar.
सम्-√ मुष् P. -मुष्णाति, to steal, rob, take away, Hariv.
सम्-√ म्यक्ष् (only 3. pl. pf. -मिमिक्षुः and -मिमिक्षिरे), to be held together or united or associated, dwell together, RV.
